title: Delay-Guided Attention for Quality Prediction in Multistage Manufacturing
abstract: arXiv:2610.29220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quality prediction in multistage manufacturing is challenging when inter-stage lags vary over time, as measurements taken at the same timestamp may reflect different process states. Existing approaches often preserve production order but fuse timestamp-aligned features or model delayed dependencies implicitly, without identifying the upstream history relevant to each downstream observation. We propose Delay-Guided Attention for Multi-stage Forecasting (DAMF), which explicitly estimates inter-stage lag distributions and uses them to guide cross-stage information transfer for final quality prediction. For each adjacent stage pair, a lag predictor compares the current downstream representation with candidate lagged upstream representations. An occurrence-magnitude factorization separately estimates the probability of a positive lag and its conditional magnitude, yielding a sample- and stage-pair-specific distribution over discrete lag state

translated_title: 多阶段制造中基于延迟引导注意力的质量预测
translated_abstract: 多阶段制造中的质量预测在阶段间延迟随时间变化时极具挑战性，因为在同一时间戳采集的测量数据可能反映不同的工艺状态。现有方法通常保留生产顺序，但融合的是时间戳对齐的特征，或者隐式地建模延迟依赖关系，而没有识别与每个下游观测相关的上游历史信息。我们提出了面向多阶段预测的延迟引导注意力方法，该方法显式地估计阶段间延迟分布，并利用这些分布来引导跨阶段信息传递，从而实现最终质量预测。对于每个相邻阶段对，延迟预测器将当前下游表示与候选的延迟上游表示进行比较。通过发生-幅值分解，分别估计正延迟发生的概率及其条件幅值，从而得到针对每个样本和阶段对的离散延迟状态分布。
tldr: 该论文提出了DAMF方法，通过显式估计阶段间延迟分布并利用其引导跨阶段信息传递，解决了多阶段制造中延迟随时间变化导致的质量预测难题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DAMF, which explicitly estimates inter-stage lag distributions and uses them to guide cross-stage information transfer, addressing the challenge of quality prediction in multistage manufacturing with time-varying lags.
